newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Fedex launches new boxes into Asia-Pacific market.
newsitem.headline: Fedex launches new boxes into Asia-Pacific market.

text.p: Federal Express Corporation is launching its 10 and 25 kg boxes into the Asia-Pacific market this week, the company said in a statement.
Service for the new box products includes customs clearance, door to door delivery and time certain guarantees with delivery commitments ranging from one to three days.
Customers can also save 30 percent off shipping costs when they use the 25 kgs box and 20 percent with the 10 kg box, the statement added.
